shared_elements: low-relief carving arranged in stacked horizontal registers
row of repeated circular discs / ring motifs
horizontal band of repeated small vertical or arched signs across the top
framing border line at the edge of the carved field
justification: Both surfaces show shallow relief organised into stacked horizontal registers, with a band of small repeated signs above and rows of circular disc/ring motifs below, and both use flat, schematic outlined forms with plain infill. The decisive difference is that B's registers are populated by clearly identifiable creatures in profile (a quadruped, a bird, a serpentine form) interacting with discs and objects, whereas A shows only abstract repeated ring and block motifs with no recognisable animal or figural subject.
